description: Points a subdomain (for example play.example.com) at a game server or website. Groups: a (IPv4), aaaa (IPv6), cname (hostname) and srv (Minecraft Java on a non-default port). The apply link always passes groupId and only the variables of those groups.
variableDescription: ip: IPv4 address of the server; ip6: IPv6 address of the server; target: hostname of the server; port: TCP port of the Minecraft server
